verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is itself a plain C/C++ inference library with ggml underneath and can be built from source, so developers can implicitly build against it as a native library. The evidence never describes a documented official SDK, a public API surface, or official language bindings; the Python wrappers mentioned by a community user are not shown to be official. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK/API documentation, official bindings for other languages (e.g., Python/JS), and corroboration of developers building apps against the library API.
